page.overview:
Who is Ant-Thony?

Ant-Thony is a Marvel Super Heroes minifigure that appears in LEGO Marvel's Avengers. He also appears as a brick-built figure in 76039 Ant-Man Final Battle.

Ant-Thony is the ant that Ant-Man favours as a mount. He was ridden by Scott Lang when trying to infiltrate Pym Technologies, now run by Darren Cross.
